# Your workshop skill

In the reusable prompt exercise, create a folder named `review-regression` beside this file and put your procedure in `review-regression/SKILL.md`. Use the same name in its YAML header. Describe when a tester would use it and what evidence the reviewer should return.

Open a fresh local project chat and check for `/review-regression`. Try it with the pricing change, product rules and catalogue. For the second change, use [prompt 26](../../WORKSHOP_PROMPTS.md#26-can-another-tester-reuse-your-skill) in a fresh chat on a partner’s checkout. Save its first answer before giving a hint.
